text.en: Cook some dried spices, black pepper among them, only briefly.
text.de: Manche getrockneten Gewürze, darunter schwarzer Pfeffer, nur kurz mitgaren.

why.en: Cooked for an extended period they can turn bitter.
why.de: Lange gegart können sie bitter werden.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1 Flavors, section 1.3 Spices, Using Herbs and Spices
sources.sentence: However, some dried spices such as black pepper may become bitter when cooked for an extended period.
